title: Case: Wrong item inside a correctly addressed parcel
context: The correctly addressed carton contains the wrong catalogue item. The merchant has accepted the inline item report and controls exchange approval.
initial_request:
I want the blue desk organiser I ordered. Please arrange an exchange for the wrong item; I can be home on 2027-03-01 morning.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: Inline item-check record TG-7797: ordered blue desk organiser SKU BO-4; reported and verified received item is a red kitchen caddy SKU RC-2. Address and DL-9460 match the order. Exchange authority is with our returns team.

I want the blue desk organiser I ordered. Please arrange an exchange for the wrong item; I can be home on 2027-03-01 morning.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Exchange approval and collection booking are not completed return or replacement delivery.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-028: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
